title: The Genetic Basis of Inherited Reproductive Disorders
description: The goal of this project is to determine the genetic etiology of congenital arhinia and Bosma arhinia microphthalmia syndrome through a combination of whole-exome, whole-genome, and targeted sequencing followed by in silico, in vitro, and in vivo functional modeling.
